d: US President Donald Trump has said that he would be willing to work with Democrats if the Republicans lose the upcoming midterm elections. Trump first spoke about working with Democrats on October 23, and then made another statement on October 27. Trump has also said that he will use the power to veto to bring the Democrats to negotiate and strike a deal. Trump's soft stance on the democrats comes as his ratings nosedive across the United States.
